tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: List supported golf regions and their time zones.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: List public courses in a region. Use offset to page through results.

tools.name: search_tee_times
tools.description: Search recently cached tee times for up to 50 selected courses on one date. A cache miss is not proof of no availability. After a miss, retry with refresh=true and at most three course IDs to request fresh inventory.

tools.name: prepare_alert
tools.description: Prepare a link to review and save a tee-time alert on asap.golf. This does not create or activate an alert. The golfer must open the link, sign in, review and save it, and connect a notification method to receive alerts. Use course IDs returned by search.

tools.name: create_tee_time_poll
tools.description: Create a shareable tee-time poll from up to eight search options. Availability is checked again; this does not book a tee time. Friends vote at the returned link.

tools.name: get_tee_time_poll
tools.description: Get poll options and aggregate vote counts from an asap.golf share link or poll token. Individual ballots are not returned.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prepare_alert · Private data: get_tee_time_poll · Public sink: get_tee_time_poll.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prepare_alert · Private data: get_tee_time_poll · Public sink: get_tee_time_poll

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
